source.check: the divisions, names and addresses read from the Ballymena Observer's Antrim Rural Council nomination list (5 May 1933, p. 10); the Sharvogues name checked against the Northern Whig's list of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on Wednesday 3 May 1933 and the Ballymena Observer reports that the candidates named below 'have all been returned unopposed'. Polling in County Antrim took place on 1 June 1933. The newspaper prints these twenty divisions only and does not name any further divisions of the district. Gray. Returned unopposed.
